annotations.title: Household inflation in Poland: retiree inflation, family types, income groups

description: Use for inflation of retirees and pensioners (inflacja emerycka), which price index the pension indexation formula takes this year, and inflation for family types or income groups. For overall CPI, use get_macro_indicator. Give GUS as the source and the month; say that averages are finwire.pl approximations and not a forecast of the indexation rate. Retiree inflation (inflacja emerycka): Statistics Poland CPI y/y for households of retirees and pensioners (together, retirees and pensioners separately) vs total CPI, monthly since 2018; year-to-date and annual averages of monthly readings (finwire.pl approximation, checked on total CPI against the official annual index); which index is higher under art. 89(2) of the Polish pension act (pension indexation takes the retirees and pensioners index unless total CPI is higher; this describes the data, it is not a forecast); basket shares by COICOP division from Statistics Poland CPI weights. Also Inflacja gospodarstw domowych finwire (finwire_household_inflation_index: CPI for family types and income quintiles, finwire.pl method) and official CPI by socio-economic group.

months.description: Months of retiree inflation history in the summary, default 12.
